messages.content: Which online bookstore sells 'To Kill a Mockingbird'?

function.name: add_product_to_cart
function.description: This function allows users to add a product to their cart. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

quantity.description: The number of this product to add to the cart

cart_id.description: The ID of the cart, if no ID is given a new cart is created

message.content:
**Online bookstores that sell “To Kill a Mockingbird”**

| Store | Typical Availability | Notes |
|-------|----------------------|-------|
| **Amazon** | New & used copies (paperback, hardcover, Kindle, audiobook) | Largest selection; often has multiple editions and sellers. |
| **Barnes & Noble** | New paperback & hardcover, Nook e‑book | Physical store pickup available in many U.S. locations. |
| **Book Depository** | New paperback & hardcover | Free worldwide shipping; good for international buyers. |
| **Books-A-Million** | New paperback & hardcover | U.S. retailer with online and physical stores. |
| **Powell’s Books** | New & used copies (paperback, hardcover) | Independent bookstore with a large online catalog. |
| **AbeBooks** | New & used copies, rare editions | Marketplace of independent sellers; great for collectors. |
| **Kobo** | e‑book version | Good for Kobo e‑reader users. |
| **Google Play Books** | e‑book & audiobook | Convenient for Android users. |
| **Apple Books** | e‑book & audiobook | For iOS/macOS users. |
| **Audible** | Audiobook | If you prefer listening. |

All of these platforms carry the classic novel, so you can choose based on format preference, price, shipping speed, or special editions.
